limitations: Contextual literal adaptation covers imported qualified static calls and managed class method calls
Metadata headers are generated for explicitly selected types
Constructor arguments currently require exact supported CLI types
No CLI generics, delegates, events yet
No mixed-mode PE output or ijwhost integration yet
Unsupported AST nodes are errors; this is not a conforming general C++/CLI compiler
#using directives in included headers are not shimmed yet
Properties currently cover non-indexed instance members; indexed and static properties are not enabled
Interface surrogates use C++ abstract bases; interface-only classes need an explicit Object base for Object upcasts
Interface declarations currently permit ordinary method declarations only; named/explicit interface implementations are not enabled
Managed arrays currently require rank one; no aggregate initializers or covariance
Managed destructors/finalizers, covariance metadata and managed operator metadata are explicitly rejected
Native bridges currently require extern-C scalar functions; no pointers, bool/string marshalling, callbacks or automatic native partitioning
Implicit boxing, static field initialization and multi-translation-unit linking are not implemented
WPF DirectWriteForwarder and System.Printing are not compiled by this frontend yet
Value classes currently exclude nested types, bases/interfaces, virtual methods, native pointer fields and custom zero-argument constructors
Boxing currently uses explicit safe_cast to Object; boxed value handles, constrained dispatch and implicit boxing are not implemented
Tracking references currently exclude constructors, fields, byref returns, pinning and interior_ptr
